title: Page 5
content_zh:
原平之一怔，他万想不到一个公主会这样教养女儿，按照这位大长公主的人生际遇，大多数人会以为她心怀怨愤，平素里更应该是一副愤世嫉俗的怨妇模样吧？

原平之伸手握住顾惜恩的小手，敛起了嬉笑，温和地对她说：「你有个好母亲，你也被她教养得很好，很让人喜欢。」

顾惜恩板着的小脸陡然绽放出一个明媚的笑容，宛如一朵羞怯的花突然绽放出了最华美的姿态，让原平之心头一悸，这小丫头当真有点颠倒众生的本事。

顾惜恩第一次笑得这么甜美，说：「夫君也这么认为吗？我也认为我娘是天下最好的母亲。」

原平之点了点头，心底却在叹息。是的，升平大长公主或许是一个最好的母亲，却未必是个幸福的女人……

原平之自幼在大宅门长大，这些年在秦楼楚馆更是见识不少，多少红颜丽人在各种男人的摧残下，转瞬就变得凄凉寥落，让人不忍卒睹。

对于男人来说，或许只是无心之失，甚至在他们心目中未必觉得自己真的就有「过失」，可是一个个女人就因为他们这样那样的无心之失而凋零枯萎了。

就像他三哥的生母，就像升平大长公主。

原平之也没了胃口，放下筷子，亲自倒了两杯暖茶，递给顾惜恩一杯，说：「漱漱口，再坐坐，便准备休息吧，夜深了。」

顾惜恩点点头，小脸红红的，乌溜溜的大眼四下转动，就是不敢再看原平之一眼。

原平之好笑，她不会以为今夜他们真的要「洞房」吧？

正在这时，外间值夜的大丫鬟和冰轻声禀告：「少爷，孙嬷嬷来了，说奉了大人的命来传几句话。」

原平之皱了皱眉头，站起身，顾惜恩也急忙跟着站起来，原平之摆摆手，说：「你先休息，我出去看看。是母亲身边的嬷嬷，应该没什么事的。」

顾惜恩乖巧地点头，只是眼神中多少有几分不安。

作为新媳妇，没有几个不害怕婆婆的。

原平之走出内室，在外间看到了已经满头花白头发的孙嬷嬷，孙嬷嬷是母亲的陪嫁，如今也上了年纪，不知道这大半夜的，怎么会劳动她老人家过来？

母亲亲自安排了这桩婚事，总不会再临时反悔，难为屋里面的那个小丫头吧？

「少爷。」看到原平之走出来，孙嬷嬷赶紧站起来，放下了手里的茶杯，屈膝施礼。

「嬷嬷。」原平之向她点点头，他也算是孙嬷嬷看着长大的，对她还是挺尊重。「母亲深更半夜的，怎么劳烦你过来了？」

孙嬷嬷和郑氏一样，也是最为偏疼这个小主子，她看着原平之，慈爱地笑了，连脸上深深的皱纹都显得和蔼许多。

她靠近原平之，压低声音道：「夫人是有几句重要的话要对您说。」

「喔？」原平之挑眉，连他大婚的事都瞒着他，如今却有重要话嘱咐了？

似乎明白原平之心中的不满，孙嬷嬷也无奈地笑笑，才继续压低声音道：「夫人说，四夫人虽然嫁进了咱家，可年龄实在太小，不宜圆房，所以……」

原平之顿时明白了母亲的意思，他似笑非笑地瞥了孙嬷嬷一眼，问：「既然如此，又何必为我选这么一位新娘子呢？娶了媳妇却不能洞房，我娘诚心要让我不好过是吧？」

孙嬷嬷急忙摇头，说：「哎，我的小少爷，别说这话。天底下还有比夫人更疼爱您的人吗？之所以挑选了顾小姐，也是夫人多方考虑的结果，也是为了您好。」

原平之「哼」了一声，甩甩袖子道：「我知道了，你回去吧。」

说完，他转身要回内室，孙嬷嬷急忙一把拉住他，说：「少爷，夫人的意思是问，您今晚是否歇在西间里？或者书房也好。」

藤萝馆主屋是小五间，东里间做了洞房，东次间是起居间，也是丫鬟值夜的地方，西里间同样是卧室，布置得更清爽些，适宜夏日居住，西次间则做了内书房。

郑氏让儿子住到西间卧室，显然是想分开儿子和儿媳妇，不让他们同房。

在郑氏的眼里，顾惜恩真的太小了，如果任凭儿子和她同房共宿，谁也不能保证儿子是否把持得住，如果有个万一，那真是糟蹋幼苗。媳妇虽然娶进了门，但怎么也要等她满了十五岁，到了及笄之年再圆房。

可是，听了孙嬷嬷的话，原平之却勃然变色，大怒道：「我又没病没痛的，洞房花烛夜为什么要和新娘子盖王缶贝分居？娶不娶由你们，睡不睡还要随你们，那我这个新郎有什么用？我看这婚不成才好，赶紧把顾小姐送回公主府好了！」

骄纵任性的四公子终于大爆发了。

他真是受够了！

男人怎能如此窝囊，任凭内宅妇人揉捏？

他才不要！

顾惜恩既然嫁给他，就要由他来安排！

和不和她洞房，是他的事！

就算他要辣手摧花又怎样？谁叫她这么赶着嫁人呀？

真当他是菩萨心肠喔？他好心接管一个小可怜，就活该要守三年空房，看着水灵灵的小妻子却不能动口，这是哪门子的道理啊？好人就活该受委屈？

孙嬷嬷从小看惯了原四耍小性子，知道他不过是纸老虎，样子虽然可怕却没有杀伤力，所以根本不以为意，继续笑咪咪地说道：「夫人怎么舍得让少爷独守空房呢？」

说罢，孙嬷嬷的眼神瞄向一直乖巧站在一旁的和冰、和玉，以及顾惜恩的两个陪嫁大丫鬟秋水、秋月，又说：「这不是有现成的人儿吗？大长公主也不是不讲理的人，知道她闺女就这么嫁过来，是委屈了少爷，所以提前言明了秋水与秋月是特意安排给少爷的侍寝。」

原平之无语。

这都是什么事儿？

虽然在大户人家里，新娘子的陪嫁大丫鬟多数就等于默认为姑爷的通房，但是讲究的人家还是不乐意主动替自家姑爷安排侍寝的，否则置自家闺女于何地啊？难不希望自己女儿嫁个专情的好夫君？

但是升平大长公主也实在无奈，她的病来得突兀又凶险，病倒之后就再也起不来了，而太医也无奈地对皇帝说她时日无多，就算华佗再世，恐怕也回天乏力，这让她根本来不及细细为自己女儿谋划，而她更不放心把女儿交给丈夫去照管，光看顾家公婆重男轻女的那个样儿，顾惜恩到了顾家，还不知道要受怎样的委屈，将来说不定还会被随便嫁出去。

顾家也是勋贵世家，家底还是颇为厚重，否则顾家公婆也不会有胆子敢对堂堂一国公主不敬，虽然只是偷偷地耍些手段，但真要计较起来，足以让皇帝治他们一个藐视皇亲的罪名。皇帝玄昱之所以忍下了，也是因为顾家以前的功绩，另外还要考虑外界的议论，毕竟大家都觉得生儿子是天经地义的事，公主也不能让人断子绝孙吧？

顾家既然有本钱骄横，就绝对不会把公主所生的女儿看在眼里，这也是升平大长公主宁可擅自把小小的女儿嫁出去，托付他人，也不肯交还给顾家的最大原因。

但是不管她把女儿嫁给谁，刚满十二岁的女孩子也无法立即圆房，虽然有专门喜好玩弄小女孩的禽兽，但是大长公主绝对不允许别人这样对待自己未发育成熟的女儿。

女孩子在癸水来临之前，不仅骨骼未长好，属于女性的器官更尚未发育完全，硬要行房，对她的身体损害非常大，而且很容易造成女孩的早逝。
content_en:
Yuan Ping was stunned. He would never have imagined that a princess would raise her daughter like this. According to the life experience of this eldest princess, most people would think that she is resentful. She should be more of a cynical and resentful woman, right?

Yuan Pingzhi stretched out his hand to hold Gu Xien's little hand, suppressed his laughter, and said to her gently: "You have a good mother, and you have been well-educated by her. You are very popular."

Gu Xien's stern little face suddenly bloomed into a bright smile, like a shy flower suddenly blooming into its most beautiful posture, which made Yuan Pingzhi's heart tremble. This little girl really has the ability to confuse all living beings.

Gu Xien smiled so sweetly for the first time and said, "Does your husband think so too? I also think that my mother is the best mother in the world."

Yuan Pingzhi nodded, but sighed in his heart.Yes, Princess Shengping may be the best mother, but she may not be a happy woman...

Yuan Pingzhi grew up in the mansion gate since he was a child, and he has seen a lot in Qinlou and Chuguan in these years. How many beauties have become desolate and desolate in an instant under the torture of various men, which is unbearable to see.

For men, it may be just an unintentional mistake, and they may not even feel that they are really "at fault" in their minds, but women have withered and withered because of their unintentional mistakes.

Just like his third brother's biological mother, just like the eldest princess Shengping.

Yuan Pingzhi lost his appetite, put down his chopsticks, poured two cups of warm tea himself, handed one to Gu Xi'en, and said, "Rinse your mouth, sit down, and get ready to rest. It's late at night."

Gu Xien nodded, her face turned red, her big black eyes moved around, but she didn't dare to look at Yuan Ping again.

Yuan Pingzhi is funny. She doesn't think they are really going to have a "bridal chamber" tonight, right?

At this time, the maid He Bing who was on night duty outside reported softly: "Master, Grandma Sun is here and she said that she has been ordered by the Lord to pass on a few words."

Yuan Pingzhi frowned and stood up. Gu Xien also stood up hurriedly. Yuan Pingzhi waved his hand and said, "You rest first, I'll go out and take a look. She's the nanny next to my mother. She should be fine."

Gu Xien nodded obediently, but there was a bit of uneasiness in his eyes.

As a new daughter-in-law, there are few who are not afraid of their mother-in-law.

Yuan Pingzhi walked out of the inner room and saw Grandma Sun, who had gray hair outside. Grandma Sun was her mother's dowry and was now elderly. She didn't know why she came to work for her in the middle of the night.

My mother arranged this marriage herself, so she would never regret it at the last moment, and it would be hard for the little girl in the house, right?

"Master." Seeing Yuan Pingzhi coming out, Grandma Sun quickly stood up, put down the teacup in her hand, and curtsied.

"Mommy." Yuan Pingzhi nodded to her. He could be regarded as having grown up under the eyes of Grandma Sun, so he still respected her."Mom, it's so late at night, why bother you to come here?"

Like Mrs. Zheng, Grandma Sun was also the most fond of this little master. She looked at Yuan Pingzhi and smiled lovingly, even the deep wrinkles on her face looked much kinder.

She approached Yuan Pingzhi and lowered her voice: "Madam, I have some important words to say to you."

"Oh?" Yuan Pingzhi raised his eyebrows. He even hid his wedding from him, but now he has important instructions?

Seemingly understanding Yuan Pingzhi's dissatisfaction, Grandma Sun also smiled helplessly, and then continued to lower her voice: "Madam said that although the fourth lady married into our family, she is too young to consummate the marriage, so..."

Yuan Pingzhi immediately understood what his mother meant. He glanced at Grandma Sun with a half-smile and asked, "In that case, why did you choose such a bride for me? My mother sincerely wants to make it difficult for me if she marries a daughter-in-law but cannot get married."

Grandma Sun shook her head hurriedly and said, "Hey, my young master, don't say that. Is there anyone in the world who loves you more than Madam? The reason why I chose Miss Gu is the result of Madam's many considerations, and it is also for your own good."

Yuan Pingzhi let out a "hum", flicked his sleeves and said, "I understand, you can go back."

After saying that, he turned around to go back to the inner room. Grandma Sun quickly grabbed him and said, "Master, Madam wants to ask if you will rest in the west room tonight? Or the study."

The main house of Wengluo Pavilion has five small rooms. The east room is used as a wedding room. The east room is a living room and a place where the maids stay at night. The west room is also a bedroom with a more refreshing layout and is suitable for summer living. The west room is used as a study room.

Mrs. Zheng let her son live in the west bedroom, apparently to separate her son and daughter-in-law and prevent them from sharing the same room.

In Zheng's eyes, Gu Xi'en is really too young. If her son is allowed to sleep in the same room with her, no one can guarantee whether her son will be able to control it. If anything happens, it will really ruin the seedling.Although the daughter-in-law is married, she still has to wait until she reaches fifteen years old before consummating the marriage.

However, after hearing what Grandma Sun said, Yuan Pingzhi suddenly changed his expression and said angrily: "I'm not sick or in pain. Why do I have to separate from the bride Gai Wang Foubei on the wedding night? It's up to you whether you marry or not. It's up to you whether you want to sleep or not. So what's the use of me as a groom? I don't think this marriage can work out, so I'll send Miss Gu back to the princess's house!"

The arrogant and willful Fourth Young Master finally exploded.

He's had enough!

How can a man be so cowardly and allow himself to be manipulated by a woman at home?

He doesn't want it!

Since Gu Xien married him, he must make the arrangements!

Whether he wants to have sex with her or not is his business!

So what if he wants to destroy the flower with his own hands?Who told her to be in such a hurry to get married?

Do you really think he has a Bodhisattva heart?He kindly took over a poor little girl, but he deserved to have to keep the vacant house for three years, but he couldn't speak when he looked at his beautiful little wife. What kind of logic is this?Do good people deserve to be wronged?

Grandma Sun was used to seeing Yuan Si acting petty since she was a child. She knew that he was just a paper tiger. Although he looked scary, he had no lethality, so she didn't take it seriously at all. She continued to smile and said: "Why is Madam willing to let the young master guard the empty room alone?"

Having said that, Grandma Sun glanced at He Bing and He Yu who had been standing aside obediently, as well as Gu Xien's two maids Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue, and said, "Isn't there someone ready? The eldest princess is not an unreasonable person. She knows that her daughter has wronged the young master by marrying like this, so she made it clear in advance that Qiu Shui and Qiu Yue were specially arranged for the young master to sleep with him."

Yuan Pingzhi was speechless.

What is all this about?

Although in a wealthy family, most of the bride's maids are regarded as the uncle's wife by default, but discerning families are still not willing to take the initiative to arrange a bed for their uncle, otherwise where would they put their daughters?Don’t you want your daughter to marry a good and dedicated husband?

But the eldest princess Shengping was really helpless. Her illness came suddenly and dangerously, and she never got up after falling ill. The imperial doctor also helplessly told the emperor that she didn't have much time left. Even if Hua Tuo was reincarnated, she might not be able to save her life, which left her with no time.She was planning carefully for her daughter, and she was even more worried about leaving her daughter in the care of her husband. Just looking at the way Gu's parents-in-law favored boys over girls, Gu Xi'en didn't know what kind of injustice she would suffer when she arrived at the Gu family, and she might be married off casually in the future.

The Gu family is also an aristocratic family, and the family wealth is quite rich, otherwise the Gu family's parents-in-law would not have the courage to disrespect the princess of the country. Although they are just playing tricks secretly, if they really want to calculate it, it is enough for the emperor to charge them with contempt for the royal family.The reason why Emperor Xuan Yu endured it was because of the Gu family's previous achievements, and he also had to consider the opinions of the outside world. After all, everyone felt that having a son was a matter of course, and a princess couldn't have her children cut off, right?

Since the Gu family is wealthy and arrogant, they will never look down upon the daughter born to the princess. This is the biggest reason why Princess Shengping would rather marry off her little daughter without authorization and entrust it to others than return it to the Gu family.

But no matter who she marries her daughter to, a girl who has just turned twelve years old cannot consummate the marriage immediately. Although there are animals who like to play with little girls, the eldest princess will never allow others to treat her immature daughter like this.

Before the advent of Guishui, a girl's bones have not grown well, and her female organs have not yet fully developed. If she insists on having sex, it will cause great damage to her body, and it will easily lead to the girl's early death.
